architecturalAssertions.assertion: Eight identical houses, each sharing one front door among eight original dwellings.
Each house is three window axes wide; central slightly projecting axis houses staircase.
Central axes alternate tuit and stepped gable crowns.
Ground floor plus three upper storeys and attic under saddle roof.
Between crowns, simple profiled eaves gutter with double sawtooth brick detail.
Dark brown brick with yellow horizontal pressed-brick bands, first-floor underside with mouse-tooth detail.
House boundaries marked by pilaster strips containing narrow toilet windows.
Most original double sliding windows replaced with casements losing original glazing-bar arrangement.
Modern doors replace original paired timber doors with transoms.
Block encloses central unbuilt private gardens, which must remain open.
